title: Physics Mock Test №7
subtitle: 45 tasks • 55 scored items • 3 hours • with formula sheet and calculator

cards.title: Quantum and nuclear physics
formulas: Conservation laws for A and Z

questions.text: The initial speed of a car is 10 m/s and its acceleration is −2 m/s². Determine the distance (m) it travels before stopping.
Forces of 20 N and 55 N act on a 5 kg body resting on a smooth horizontal surface. Find the minimum acceleration of the body (m/s²).
An airplane flies at an altitude of 7200 m at a constant speed of 216 km/h. How many times is its potential energy greater than its kinetic energy?
The graph shows how the speed of a body moving in a straight line changes. Find the distance (m) travelled by the body on section BC of the graph.
Find the initial speed of the car (m/s) if the coefficient of friction between the wheels and the asphalt is 0.45.
A ball of mass 0.9 kg tied to a 1.2 m string is swung in a vertical plane. If the speed of the ball at the lowest point is 4 m/s, find the tension in the string (N) at that moment.

Balls of masses m and 2m are hung from the weightless pulleys shown in the figure. Ball A is moved with acceleration g/2 vertically upward, and ball B with acceleration g/2 vertically downward. Find the ratio F₁/F₂.

A building has several granite columns, each of volume 9 m³ and base area 1.4 m². The density of granite is 2800 kg/m³. Determine the pressure (kPa) that one column exerts on the foundation due to its own weight.

A powerful suction pump is installed 5 m above the surface of water. The pump is connected to the water surface by a pipe. Determine the maximum speed of the water (m/s) in this pipe while the pump is operating.
The distance between the 1st and 3rd crests of a wave on the water surface is 20 cm and its propagation speed is 0.1 m/s. Find the period of oscillation of the wave (s).
The pressure of an ideal gas is 2.5·10⁵ Pa and its density is 12 kg/m³. Find the root-mean-square speed of the gas molecules (m/s).
An aluminum object of mass 0.4 kg is given. Determine its heat capacity (J/K).

Ozone (O₃) in a closed vessel is at a temperature of 727 °C. After some time all the ozone turned into oxygen (O₂) and the temperature in the vessel dropped to 600 °C. By what percentage did the pressure in the vessel decrease after these changes?

Helium is enclosed under a 20 kg piston in a vertical cylinder with a base area of 1 dm². When the helium is heated isobarically, the piston rises by 30 cm. Determine the work (J) done by the gas during expansion.

5 m³ of air at 19 °C contains 34.5 g of water vapor. Saturated vapor density ρ₀ (g/m³): 15 °C — 12.8; 16 °C — 13.6; 17 °C — 14.5; 18 °C — 15.4; 19 °C — 16.3; 20 °C — 17.3. Determine what mass of water (g) must evaporate for this air to become saturated.
The resultant of two forces acting on a charged body is 32 mN and is directed horizontally. If the force of gravity is 24 mN, determine the magnitude of the force exerted by the electric field (mN).
Determine how the ammeter reading changes if the slider of the rheostat is moved to the left.
How should the capacitance in the circuit of a radio receiver tuned to a frequency of 6 MHz be changed in order to receive a radio station operating at a wavelength of 200 m?

A substance with dielectric constant ε was inserted into a parallel-plate air capacitor of capacitance C. When this capacitor was connected in series with a capacitor of capacitance Cₓ, the total capacitance of the combination became C/2. Determine the capacitance Cₓ.
Two point charges of 3·10⁻⁸ C each are in air at a distance of 50 cm from each other. They are brought closer to a distance of 10 cm. Find the work (μJ) done in this process.
The emf of a chemical current source is 6 V and its internal resistance is 1/4 Ω. If the source delivers a current of 2 A to the circuit, find the voltage at its terminals (V).
The resistance of an aluminum wire at 0 °C is 3.5 Ω. Determine by how much (Ω) its resistance increases at 200 °C. α = 0.0028 K⁻¹
A rectangular frame measuring 2 cm by 3 cm is in a magnetic field of induction 10 T. Find the maximum torque (mN·m) acting on the frame when a current of 2 A flows through it.
An electron moves along the y axis in a magnetic field. The Lorentz force is directed opposite to the x axis. Determine the direction of the magnetic field.

An alternating voltage with an rms value of 140 V is applied to a circuit made of an 8 Ω resistance, a 9 Ω capacitive reactance and a 3 Ω inductive reactance connected in series. Find the useful power in the circuit (W).
A light ray of wavelength λ is incident on a liquid with refractive index 4/3 and is refracted. Determine how the frequency of the light changes.
A lens forms a virtual image of an object located 40 cm from it, reduced 2 times. Determine the optical power of this lens (D).
The mass of a moving body is m = (5/3)m₀, where m₀ is the rest mass of the body. Find the speed of the body.
Determine the composition of the ²⁰⁹₈₄Po nucleus.

Photons of frequency 5ν fall on the surface of a metal with a photoelectric threshold frequency ν, and photons of frequency 4ν fall on the surface of a metal with a threshold frequency 2ν. If the maximum kinetic energies of the emitted photoelectrons are E₁ and E₂ respectively, find the value of E₁/E₂.
An electron in a hydrogen atom made a transition from the 4th quantum state to the 2nd. Find the energy of the emitted photon (eV).
A student who measured the length of a rope wrote the result as l = (17.2 ± 0.005) m. Find the relative error of the measurement (%).
Find the work done by the gas (over the cycle).

questions.text: A body is thrown with an initial velocity from a height of 175 m and falls freely; during the 2nd second it covers 25 m.

parts.text: Find the initial speed of the body.
Determine the distance the body travels in the first 4 s.

questions.text: The length of the string of a simple pendulum at the Earth's surface is 0.5 m. This pendulum was moved to planet Y, whose mass and radius are 2 times those of the Earth.

parts.text: Determine the acceleration of free fall near the surface of planet Y.
Find the ratio of the pendulum's oscillation period on planet Y when moving upward with an acceleration of 5 m/s² to its period when rising uniformly at the Earth's surface.

questions.text: Weights of P and 20 N are hung from the ends of a thin string passed over a weightless fixed pulley. 2.5 s after starting from rest, the 20 N weight has descended 6.25 m.

parts.text: Find the acceleration of the weights.
Determine the force acting on the axle of the pulley during the motion.

questions.text: A closed vessel of volume 400 L contains unsaturated air at 27 °C. If 2 g of water is evaporated in the vessel, the water vapor in it becomes saturated. The partial pressure of saturated water vapor is 3.6 kPa.

parts.text: Find the absolute humidity of the initial air.
Find the relative humidity of the initial air.

questions.text: A monatomic ideal gas was given 6 kJ of heat. In this process the volume and absolute temperature of the gas are related by V = k√T, where k is a constant.

parts.text: Find the work done by the gas in this process.
Find by how much the internal energy of the gas increased in this process.

questions.text: The emf of the battery of an electric car of mass 1200 kg is 400 V. The electric car reduced its speed from 30 m/s to 5 m/s.

parts.text: Determine how much energy is stored in the electric car's battery in this process.
Determine how much charge is stored in the electric car's battery in this process.

questions.text: In the circuit R = 60 Ω, L = 0.2 H and u = 160·sin(400t) [V].

parts.text: Find the ammeter reading when the switch is in position a.
Determine the ammeter reading when the switch is in position b.

questions.text: A lens produces an image b of an object a magnified 5/4 times. The distance between the object and the image is 2 cm.

parts.text: Find the optical power of the lens.
Determine the magnification of the lens if the object is moved 3 cm closer to the lens.

questions.text: The mass of a particle moving at a speed of 0.5c is m/√3.

parts.text: Find the rest mass of the particle. Write the answer in the form m: enter the numerical coefficient in front of m.
Find the kinetic energy of the particle moving at a speed of 0.6c. Write the answer in the form mc²: enter the numerical coefficient in front of mc².

questions.text: The ionization energy of an excited hydrogen atom is 3.4 eV.

parts.text: Determine the ionization energy of the atom if, by absorbing a photon, it increased its angular momentum by ħ.
Determine the ionization energy if the initial atom, by emitting a photon, decreased its angular momentum by ħ.
